summary: FD_TC_148_EU 261 | No Determination | MSL Data Missing | 14-Day Polling Exhausted | Manual Handling
title: EU 261 | No Determination | MSL Data Missing | 14-Day Polling Exhausted | Manual Handling
description:
EU-originating flight (CDG?YYZ) was disrupted but critical MSL data is MISSING from backend � operating times, flight number details, and ALL disruption codes (arrival, departure, cancellation) are unavailable. DDS cannot calculate delay, determine controllability, or assess any regime. The system retries daily for 14 days (automatic polling). After 14 days with no data, the case is forwarded for manual handling with a 30-day SLA. This is the EU counterpart to APPR TC_072 (ND-05). Validates: (1) All three code types missing simultaneously triggers ND, (2) 14-day retry window is exhausted before ND is declared, (3) Manual handling includes 30-day SLA and agent action items.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Fran�ois Girard (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 879, CDG?YYZ. Flight date: May 5, 2026. Trip Tracer data status: INCOMPLETE � actual arrival time NOT populated; operating times MISSING; ALL codes (arrival, departure, cancellation) = NULL. Scheduled arrival: Available (from booking). Actual arrival: MISSING. 14-day retry window: EXHAUSTED (May 8�May 22, all polls returned "data missing"). Regime: EU 261 (CDG = EU origin) + APPR (YYZ = Canada). Filing date: May 28, 2026 (23 days post-disruption).
